Standard Stability. PEEK posterior body, titanium anterior body. Height 6–9mm stock (to 14mm special order). Depth 13 or 15mm, width 15 or 17mm.
Serrated Radial Ribs (SRR). Same footprints/heights for enhanced stability during implantation. Not compatible with the Graft Block — ribs won't seat correctly in the block.

Cover Plates

Ti-6Al-4V · prevents screw back-out
Loads onto the Cover Plate Holder (83-9041), driven with the torque-limiting Cover Plate Driver (83-9042) — audible & tactile "click-out" confirms tightening.
Implant heightArticle no.Range
6 – 9mm83-7110Standard
10 – 14mm83-7120Special order
i

Always defer to surgeon judgment & the full Instructions For Use.

1

Position

Supine, neutral–slight extension. At C6-7, check shoulders don't block the lateral x-ray.

2

Expose & discectomy

Standard anterior approach. Confirm level, complete discectomy and endplate prep.

3

Rasp, trial & insert spacer

Rasp endplates, trial for a tight footprint/height/lordosis fit. Attach the Inserter, pack graft, seat to the tantalum markers (2mm from posterior edge) under fluoro.

!

No depth stop on rasps/trials/inserter — impact only as far as intended.

4

Prepare screw holes

Awl (straight or angled) or self-tapping drill + guide, under lateral fluoro. Place the first screw before prepping the second hole.

5

Place screws

Driver (straight or jointed) self-retains the screw — thread finger-tight, then fully tighten both once placed.

Screws seated & recessed — confirm on lateral fluoro
!

Don't over-tighten — strips the spacer's screw hole.

6

Cover plate

Load plate onto the Holder, seat in the recess, drive the Cover Plate Screw with the torque-limiting Driver until it click-outs.

7

Removal (if needed)

Reverse order: cover plate screw out → bone screws out → Inserter on, pull spacer.
